critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1275 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, intermediary, feedback, analytics, ai) to improve maintainability.
AI insight endpoints are called synchronously per page-load and take 4-8s — consider caching results per user for short TTL (e.g. 5 min) to avoid re-billing Gemini on every dashboard/account refresh.
Frontend intermediary AI insight showed 'Sto analizzando…' placeholder for ~6-8s; consider showing a skeleton/spinner and/or streaming to improve perceived latency.

consult-analytics-card 'Cosa consulti di più' displays counts as ' · N' next to labels — spacing is fine but ensure the section '(E)' collaboratori mapping is applied consistently (labels look correct: 'Collaboratori / Addetti · 3').
Cronologia consultazioni items display 'Collaboratori / Addetti · ()' when comune/provincia missing — consider hiding the parentheses when empty.
